note: Names and general nature only. No amounts, deadlines or criteria until verified from the funder's own site.

bursaries.name: NSFAS
bursaries.summary: Funding for eligible students at public universities and public TVET colleges.
bursaries.note: Apply through the official NSFAS channels only. It is free.

bursaries.name: Funza Lushaka (DBE)
bursaries.summary: Bursary for people training to become teachers.

bursaries.name: SETA learnerships and bursaries
bursaries.summary: Sector bodies (e.g. merSETA, MICT SETA, CETA) fund learnerships, apprenticeships and some bursaries.
bursaries.note: Each SETA has its own rules and calendar.

bursaries.name: Employer and corporate bursaries
bursaries.summary: Companies fund study in scarce skills, often with work-back conditions.
bursaries.note: Check each company's own careers page.

bursaries.name: University and faculty bursaries
bursaries.summary: Many institutions have their own merit and need-based funds.
bursaries.note: Ask the institution's financial aid office.
